scope: Native mock opening/migration/restore acceptance; final browser review still pending

limits: Native required-case/file pass and inspected assertions; no per-case JSON receipt was requested. This is not final combined browser/mock-pilot signoff or real-hotel rollout.

recoveryVerification: Supplied release must be inside local .runtime/releases
release.sourceFingerprint must match supplied fingerprint and Node24.20.0
release-files manifest hash and every compiled file checksum verified before backup
8database table digests and3Holding files compared after restore
compatible rollback keeps immutable table digests; incompatible schema and ciphertext tampering rejected
migrationVerification: migrations read from supplied compiled release directory
original price quote/FX preserved and unquoted history not invented
compiledCandidateBindingAudit.structuredRawRehearsalExport: Not requested in this full native command: ERPX_ENGINEERING_EVIDENCE_DIR absent. Passing assertion/file log is retained; no raw JSON rehearsal receipt is invented. Earlier dated rehearsal artifacts belong to earlier fingerprints.
